Message:
Despite the sharpened stick
pierced deep into her wing,
Mother still stood before me
to shield me from harm.

But, I was never
Mother’s daughter after all...
So, there’s no need for her
to protect me anymore...

Just then, Mother told me
that in a gentle tone...

“Since you bore the same power
as a knight who once came here,
I feared you at first.

But, seeing you mistake me
for your mother, and follow
after me just like a nestling...
I decided to raise you as my own.”

“That is why you must
decide for yourself as well.

When the invader
raised their weapon,
Brother came down from the sky.

Then, the other animals appeared
as well...their small bodies
all running towards the other
humans gathered there.

Wh-What should I do...?
If I’m part of this forest,
should I fight them...?

...No, that’s not right.
I need to think for myself.
What do I want to do...?
